{{Top|leg}}
The '''Feraleechi Onetime Loop''' was an encryption which involved a multiple-step process to get to the final message. Called a "onetime loop" because the code was set to trigger on certain days on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].

A keyword in the morning news provided a way to partially decipher the code, revealing a number series that referred to a group of tedious-to-read texts, which kept them out of the mainstream. Once the text was located they were translated from [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] into [[Symbian]]. Then, every sixth word was transposed to reveal the original message. This system of securing messages was adopted by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to ensure that even the most basic communication was not deciphered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
